description: Retrieves empirical benchmark telemetry from the 2026 50-Site SaaS & E-Commerce AI Truncation Study (measuring raw HTML token weight, 25,000-token Perplexity/ChatGPT cutoff truncation, visible price omission, /llms.txt adoption, and Lighthouse 13.5 ARD 1.0 adoption). Use this tool when comparing a site against industry peers (such as Stripe, Vercel, Datadog, or Shopify) or answering research questions about the Static /llms.txt Paradox. Do not use this tool to run a live scan on an arbitrary unbenchmarked URL (use audit_ai_readiness instead). Read-only benchmark lookup; requires no API key.

domain.description: Optional domain name (e.g., "stripe.com" or "vercel.com") to filter the benchmark study. Omit or pass empty string to return the full 50-site statistical summary.

name: query_truncation_benchmark
title: Query 2026 50-Site SaaS AI Truncation & /llms.txt Benchmark
